newsitem.title: USA: Ohio consumers object Ameritech late charge.
newsitem.headline: Ohio consumers object Ameritech late charge.

text.p: The Ohio Consumers' Counsel said Wednesday it filed objections to Ameritech Corp's request to add a 1.5 percent late payment charge on residential customer bills in Ohio.
A late payment fee would violate an agreement prohibiting Ameritech from filing for a rate increase on most residential telephone services until 2000, the Consumer's Counsel said.
An Ameritech spokeswoman disputed the late payment charge would constitute a rate increase.
"If you are a customer in Ohio, it doesn't affect you if you pay your bills on time," she said. She added the utilities commission already approved a 1.5 percent late payment charge for businesses.
The Consumers' Counsel said Ameritech filed a similar request in June 1995 but later withdrew the filing because of concerns voiced by consumer groups.
Ameritech filed the request with the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio on June 2. The Consumers' Counsel filed objections on behalf of a consumer coalition.
